statement: The complete minimal request Cell routing candidate lands as one exact unit with durable single-effect fencing and bounded shutdown: active ingress dispatches receive one cancellation signal through ServiceDispatcher and MessageRouter, shutdown awaits naturally drained request accounting, correlated transport response waiters are retired and absorb late responses, and already-completed component results remain durably replayable; the routing scenario passes three consecutive fresh runs and independent exact-candidate verification.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, use an independent subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The candidate must include the complete request Cell routing delta from base commit 3b215532b6931ba56fe83ffe6374736de479be2e, including durable journal fencing, request ingress and dispatch owners, transport cancellation and retired-response ownership, production storage initialization, and all focused proofs.

Shutdown must abort each active ingress request with one signal propagated through ServiceDispatcher and MessageRouter, prevent any further retry, await natural active and per-target accounting cleanup, retire the exact correlated response waiter, absorb a late response, and never discard or rearm a component result that was already durably completed.

At most one component invocation may cross concurrent runtime owners for a tenant and idempotency key, a zero-row or unknown journal compare-and-set must fail closed, and any failure after a component result exists must remain ambiguous and never be rearmed.

Preserve authenticated immutable request-Binding selection, canonical ServiceDispatcher and MessageRouter delivery, receiver-fresh admission, bounded retry and pressure, genuine processed Component responses, handoff, restart, late-response, no-handler, unmatched, ambiguous, concurrent ordering, and shutdown replay proofs.

Do not raise or weaken any static baseline; candidate-scoped checks must be clean, and broad inherited baseline failures must not grow relative to base commit 3b215532b6931ba56fe83ffe6374736de479be2e.
